title: IPv6-only listeners are advertised through unreachable IPv4 loopback URLs
test: tests/serverIntegration.test.js: 'BIND_HOST=::1 and WHIP_BIND_HOST=::1 advertise bracketed IPv6 URLs that reach the listeners and are accepted as socket origins', 'a second Nextra on the same IPv6 loopback port finds the running one instead of failing on the port' and 'BIND_HOST=localhost and WHIP_BIND_HOST=localhost advertise the loopback address the listeners really bound' (plus 'the default IPv4 binding still advertises 127.0.0.1 for the host page and WHIP', which passed before and after); unit cases in tests/listenerHost.test.js
proof: Before the fix the three tests failed against the real server. With BIND_HOST=::1 the banner printed 'Bind: ::1:PORT' and 'Local: http://127.0.0.1:PORT' ('+ actual http://127.0.0.1:56992, - expected http://[::1]:56992'), and WHIP printed http://127.0.0.1:WHIPPORT. With BIND_HOST=localhost (which Node 22 on this machine binds to ::1) the advertised 'GET http://127.0.0.1:60743/healthz did not connect: ECONNREFUSED'. A second server on the same ::1 port probed only 127.0.0.1, so it tried to listen and exited 1 with 'listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use ::1:PORT / Port PORT is already in use on ::1' (expected exit 0). After the fix the host-page URL, loopback URL, Local line, whipHttpHost ('::1') and whipHttpUrl ('http://[::1]:PORT') follow the bound family, an OPTIONS request to the advertised WHIP URL returns 204, a socket from Origin http://[::1]:PORT is accepted (while http://[::2]:PORT and, on an IPv4 bind, http://[::1]:PORT are still refused), and the second server exits 0 with 'Nextra is already running at http://[::1]:PORT.'. Commit cbcbe78 on lane/server.
